# Thirty Further Improvements Before Execution

1. Prefer additive modules over enlarging existing controllers.
2. Keep action catalog reads cacheable while account ownership remains private/no-store.
3. Add explicit schema/version fields to generated product metadata.
4. Build related-product edges from categories/tags only when evidence exists.
5. Preserve Hebrew titles and descriptions without corrupting directionality.
6. Ensure static fallback cards have semantic headings and descriptive links.
7. Avoid duplicate H1 elements after runtime enhancement.
8. Give every catalog card one clear primary action.
9. Keep marketplace copy outcome-focused rather than feature-jargon-heavy.
10. Avoid unsupported claims such as “best,” “instant,” or “AI-powered” when product metadata does not prove them.
11. Track activation only after meaningful use, not page load.
12. Track store-open source so acquisition paths can be compared without user-content logging.
13. Track insufficient-credit state separately from checkout failure.
14. Track reservation release reason for operational health, not advertising profiles.
15. Add sampling/aggregation if telemetry volume could become expensive.
16. Ensure analytics failures never break product functionality.
17. Add deterministic test fixtures for public product graph generation.
18. Add duplicate route/product ID detection.
19. Add broken relative asset/link detection for generated landing surfaces.
20. Add mobile overflow checks for long product titles.
21. Add reduced-motion checks for premium decoration.
22. Add keyboard traversal checks for commerce and catalog surfaces.
23. Add color-contrast review hooks to visual QA.
24. Add readiness summaries by app/game/category so long-tail products are visible.
25. Record startup stage duration in monotonic time.
26. Expose startup diagnostics only to logs/health tooling, never public customer APIs unless sanitized.
27. Keep the test validator outside product source; never ship temporary test-server code accidentally.
28. Stop/clean validation processes after browser verification.
29. Re-read all touched files after each write wave and compare planned vs actual.
30. End only with explicit remaining work and next action if any safe useful work remains.
